summary: Fate Therapeutics filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, reporting entry into a Sales Agreement with Leerink Partners for a $100 million at-the-market program under its existing Form S-3 shelf. Shares may be sold from time to time at the company's discretion on Nasdaq; neither party is obligated to transact. No price, premium, or minimum is stated. A replacement Form S-3 is expected to be filed as the current shelf expires November 27, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown mechanism, not a special situation; watch dilution pace and any accelerated selling.
